Meta.title: CompI · Your kitchen workspace
Meta.description: CompI brings plating guides, recipe sheets and team email together for your hotel kitchen.

Landing.lead: Your plating guides, recipe sheets and team email, all in one place.
Landing.heroAlt: A chef uses tweezers to garnish a plated fish with microgreens.
Landing.projectBody1: In a hotel kitchen, every dish passes through several hands. With CompI, the kitchen and front-of-house teams work from the same plating guide. The photo, the choice of tableware and the service notes are all there when a question comes up at the pass.
Landing.projectBody2: The chef organises the sheets by hotel and outlet. Each employee can access their team’s documents and use internal email to hand over service notes to the next shift.
Landing.toolsAlt: An open kitchen notebook beside fresh herbs and cooking utensils.
Landing.platingBody: Browse the published guides for each outlet, check how to plate each dish and download a Word or PDF copy.
Landing.recipesBody: If you have editing access, enter the ingredients, quantities, allergens and plating steps. Review the sheet and save it as a draft before publishing.
Landing.mailBody: Email your hotel colleagues, reply to shift updates and organise your messages with favourites and personal folders.
